floor_calibration.assumption: Static camera. Floor model from a person height of 1.75 m on two frames (s5: feet y=1420, height 430 px; s19: feet y=1330, height 345 px): horizon y=965 px, camera height 1.85 m; focal length 1540 px assumed for a 26 mm-equivalent phone camera (frame 1280×2276); vanishing point at the frame centre (x=640). Check: the reach truck width in frame 001 is 1.1 m by the model (reach truck spec 1.1–1.3 m), the column is 0.5 m. The 2 m reach truck length and the 2.7 m rack bay in frame 001 cannot be measured: the reach truck stands at an angle, the bays are hidden. Rectangle 3×4 m: far edge 9 m from the camera, near edge 5 m. Accuracy ±20–30 %, enough for the 2 m threshold only with a margin.
